{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Black fine-knit crew-neck sweater, fitted, hip-length, black (#1C1C1E), merino wool blend
Dark straight-leg jeans, high-rise, ankle length, deep indigo (#2B3045), stretch denim with a matte finish
Black leather ankle boots, low block heel, closed round toe, black (#171717), smooth leather
Black wool-blend biker-style jacket, tailored, cropped at the hip, black (#202020), textured wool with a matte finish
Slim leather belt, thin, black (#1A1A1A), smooth leather
Small crossbody bag, compact, worn across the body, black (#181818), grained leather
Small silver hoop earrings, thin, silver (#C0C0C0), polished metal

This outfit works because the dark, classic palette keeps the look restrained while still fitting the spirit of a rock concert. The fitted knit and straight jeans stay neat and comfortable for standing in a crowd, and the low block heel gives stable footing for hours. The cropped textured jacket adds the right autumn warmth and an edge without becoming costume-like, and the club's artificial light will bring out the depth of the black and indigo.
